(1) PRIOR TRAJECTORY iter->hr: 1->0.0508 (BEST: wu_n_bands=4, wu_n_outer=1, lr0.01, ep6, train_n=200, SSIM 0.8370, 335s, 8 params), 2(ep18)->0.0337 (epochs INERT, hr FELL), 3(n_bands 4->6)->0.0 (SSIM 0.8273, bands REGRESSED), 4(n_outer 1->2)->0.0 (SSIM 0.6459 COLLAPSED), 5(train_n 200->480, ep3)->0.0411 (SSIM 0.8384, data-coverage FAILED: hr 0.0411 <= 0.051 falsifier, did NOT clear iter-1 best). Base copied = iter-1 (highest hr). (2) LIMITER: few-param tuned-FBP ceiling ~hr0.05. Wu-trainable = band-reweighted aliasing-free FBP + soft-thresholded dense residual, NO image-domain learned CNN denoiser; sits just above LD-FBP floor, far below dual-domain U-Net families (hr~0.27). FOUR axes falsified: epochs inert, bands regressed, outer-depth collapsed, data-coverage failed. (3) ONE KNOB: optimizer lr 0.01 -> 0.003 (3.3x lower). The default lr=0.01 was NEVER probed and the SLURM log shows it saturates band_scale to its 0.1-3.0 clamp + drives loss to 0 by ep1 -- the 8 clamped scalars may be slamming into a poor basin. I REVERT to the iter-1 BEST config (wu_n_bands=4, wu_n_outer=1, ep6, train_n=200) -- NOT the regressed iter-3/4 nor the failed iter-5 -- and change ONLY lr. This is the SOLE optimization-axis lever left orthogonal to the falsified capacity/data axes; cross-solver precedent that lr is load-bearing for few-param FBP-family denoisers: breast-CT Step-3 TPE found wu_2015_trainable hr0.3170 at 10x-LOWER lr than the agentic centroid (solver_plan.md Step-2 STOP note). PARAM COUNT UNCHANGED at 8 (wu_n_bands+2+2*wu_n_outer = 4+2+2 = 8). (4) HYPOTHESIS: if the hr-0.05 ceiling is an lr/optimization-basin artifact (default lr0.01 saturates the clamped scalars too fast), a gentler lr0.003 settles them in a better basin and lifts hr above the iter-1 best 0.0508 (SSIM > 0.842, >+0.005 over the +-0.001 noise band). TERMINAL FALSIFIER: if hr <= 0.051 at lr0.003, then epochs+bands+outer-depth+data-coverage AND optimizer-lr are ALL exhausted -- Wu-trainable is STRUCTURALLY FBP-ceilinged on Mayo (no image-domain learned denoiser), caps hr~0.05 on real-helical Mayo far below the dual-domain U-Net families hr~0.27. File the terminal verdict. (5) BUDGET (HARD 1200s/20-min train+score): IDENTICAL runtime envelope to iter-1 (train_n=200, ep6, n_outer=1 = 335s in iter-1); lr is a free knob with ZERO runtime cost. Worst-case ~335s << 1200s and the 1800s SLURM kill; val FIGURE outside budget. val = ALL 214 L277 slices (do NOT reduce); grad_clip=1.0 (MANDATORY Mayo guard -- the 2304-view FBP adjoint overflows otherwise); bs=1 + val_chunk=1 forced by per-sample-ps; staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted; per-sample-ps FBP + per-sample model.proj/model.dense_proj swap; bg_target=truth; 321px detector-geometry FOV default (NO fov override); wu_n_outer=1 (MANDATORY). (6) no control return.
